findings: Blocking: observer failures affect product persistence and send handling. observe() propagates synchronous native journal exceptions. In enqueue(), an exception after persistence prevents flush(); in flush(), an exception during the settled observation enters the mutation-failure catch and removes the entry. These hooks are not isolated from application behavior.

Blocking: committed-screen observations can include unrendered rows. Chat retains the old viewability item when its ID is absent from displayRows. Search reports cached result IDs for an empty offline query while rendering results=[].

Oracle creates a fresh password-authenticated Bob session, then only queries ordinary chat history. It exhausts the exclusive sequence cursor, appends every returned occurrence, and emits raw projections with authoritative [seq, messageId] keys and receipt watermarks. The required login session creation is its only write.

Backend argv exactly matches the mandated operator-owned launcher. Seed uses the fixed backend binary only for key generation and deploys to the supplied local origin; Convex's existing-deployment branch does not start another backend.

Release wrapper uses only $1, resolving to /tmp/clique-native-pilot-convex-gt64__1n/DerivedData, with explicit Release, iphonesimulator, generic simulator destination, and build as the sole action. Preparation exports and generates sources without launching the application.

Convex 1.45.0, Expo 57.0.22, and React Native 0.86.3 are exactly pinned in package.json and package-lock.json. Native/web bundling receives CLIQUE_NATIVE_ORIGIN; Expo preserves the exported value and inlines it. Seed/oracle use the operator-supplied stdin origin.

Initial generated autolinking and Expo configuration scripts contain pre-relocation lane paths. Recorded as source-stage findings: preparation regenerates these inputs, but prepared-source qualification must inspect the resulting project and phases before compilation.
Opaque conversation/message selectors preserve independently accessible child structure in source. No execution, behavioral qualification, native-tree verification, or pixel proof was performed.
